_readme: Round v8 (case C, model alone; pre-registered 'After v7' rule, band 62-75%: more samples per word and deeper boards). Fine-tunes of SFT v7 s1 (select 74.9% alone, 97.2% word-level). Data: balanced drill with 40 samples per common word (v7: 30), deeper boards (1-5 guesses, mostly 3-5; v7: 1-4) and up to two rejected non-words per board (v7: one), plus half of the v5 teacher games as replay. Same hyperparameters as v7. GPU 0 = seed 1, GPU 1 = seed 2 (same data, different order), to measure seed variance. Each is scored alone on select and heldout, alone under retry-3, and, if alone on select is at least 70%, with word-level decoding.
